title: Grilled Pepper and Salad
description: A simple keto dish featuring grilled peppers and fresh salad, great for a quick meal.

ingredients.name: Adventurous
ingredients.notes: You can use any type of adventurous (e.g. chicken, steak, fish)

ingredients.name: Pepper
ingredients.notes: You can use any color pepper, e.g. red, green, yellow

ingredients.name: Salad
ingredients.notes: You can use any type of salad mix

instructions: Season the adventurous with salt and pepper.
Grill the adventurous for 5-6 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Grill the peppers for 3-4 minutes per side, or until slightly charred.
In a large bowl, combine the grilled adventurous and peppers.
Add the salad on top of the adventurous and peppers.
